question: What consequences in this life and after death result from neglecting the required worship?
premises: Neglect leads to poverty in this world.
Neglect leads to the state of a bound being after death.
inference: One who neglects the required worship becomes poor in this life and attains the state of a paśu after death.
plain_english: In this world one becomes poor, and when dead one attains the state of a bound being.
